subject: New version of dartR (v1.1.6) now available from CRAN

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: New version of dartR (v1.1.6) now available from CRAN
parts:
A new version of dartR (v1.1.6) now available from CRAN.

You will need R version 3.5.1 to install and run this version painlessly.

Version 1.1.6 includes a number of bug fixes (including those identified at the AusMus Workshop), and some new scripts that have been requested. Some additional scripts have been added to convert gl to PLINK, mapping points on google earth and as shape files, generating heat maps from distance matricies and more. Refer to the vignette for further information. Have fun.
